outputs.explanation: Panel A includes an H&E micrograph and spatial gene-expression heatmap plots (Log2 Exp for Tmprss11b, Krt13, Krt6a) overlaid on tissue sections. These are heatmap-type visualizations, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel B consists solely of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs; no averaged/summary plot is present, so the check does not apply.

Panel C is a scatter/dot plot showing every individual patient tumor value (LUAD n=512, LUSC n=500) with median and 95% CI overlaid; since individual points are directly plotted, the requirement is satisfied.
Panel D is a bar chart (mean ± SD) with the individual technical replicate data points (n=3 per group) overlaid as dots, satisfying the requirement to show underlying data alongside the average.
